faq_items.a: Yes! The tool is completely free and open source. You only need a TinyPNG API Key (free tier: 500 images/month) to get started.
Input supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, GIF, TIFF. Output supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, AVIF, ICO, PDF — 9 formats total.

faq_items.q: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faq_items.a: Images are sent to TinyPNG's official API for compression over encrypted connections. We do not store or forward your images — they are deleted after processing.
TinyPNG uses smart lossy compression that significantly reduces file size while remaining virtually indistinguishable to the human eye. You can also adjust compression parameters.

faq_items.q: How do I get a TinyPNG API Key?
faq_items.a: Visit tinypng.com/developers, register an account, and get your free API Key — 500 free compressions per month.

about.title: About TinyOpt Compressor
about.intro: TinyOpt Compressor is a desktop batch image compression tool based on TinyPNG API, built with Python + PyQt5. Designed for designers, operators, and developers who need to process images in bulk.
features_list: Fully offline client — images are only sent to TinyPNG API for processing
Multi-threaded concurrent compression for maximum efficiency
Flexible compression options: scale, crop, fit modes
Visual watermark editor with real-time preview
about.project_bg: This project started in late 2025. The author frequently needed to process large volumes of images in daily work, and existing tools were either too limited or too complex. So we decided to build a comprehensive desktop tool integrating compression, watermarking, format conversion, and batch renaming. After multiple iterations, TinyOpt has evolved into a feature-rich and stable image processing tool.
about.philosophy: Our design philosophy is 'simple and efficient' — open and use, no complex configuration needed; batch processing, one-click completion of the entire workflow. Making image processing no longer a bottleneck in design work.
about.github: This project is fully open-source on GitHub. Stars, Issues, and contributions are welcome.
about.tech_stack: Tech Stack: Python 3.12 + PyQt5 + Pillow + TinyPNG API
about.license: This is a personal open-source project, free to use.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: TinyOpt Compressor respects and protects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.
1. Information Collection: Your TinyPNG API Key is stored locally in a config file and is never uploaded to any third-party server.
2. Image Processing: All images are processed via the official TinyPNG API. We do not store or forward your images.
3. Logging: Compression history is stored locally and never automatically uploaded.
4. Third-Party Services: This tool uses the TinyPNG API. Please refer to TinyPNG's privacy policy for their data handling.
5. Contact: For privacy-related questions, please reach out through our contact channels.
